source_prompt: Put the bowl on the plate. Keep the wine bottle at its current position and orientation.

arms.O: Put the bowl on top of the cabinet. Keep the wine bottle at its original position and orientation.
arms.A: Put the bowl on top of the cabinet.
arms.B: Put the bowl on top of the cabinet. The wine bottle is also visible in the current scene.
arms.T: Put the bowl on top of the cabinet. The table surface is also visible in the current scene.

calibration.rule: After 10 warmup controls, compare 300 zero-control states to t0. Use seed 23 only to fit, using the midpoint of its maximum zero-control drift and the measured pure 10 mm or 5 degree positive for each channel. Check seed 7 with the same frozen thresholds, verify single-channel positives and quaternion sign reversal. Fail if there is no separating threshold. Perturb only the calibration scene. Freeze before running either policy branch.

measurement: Sample after each control. From a copy of current qpos, run native forward kinematics in separate MjData. Archive world position, scalar-first quaternion, rotation matrix and bottle free-joint pose. Score translation norm and shortest quaternion angle to the original t0, never recenter at the revision. Use an independent rotation-matrix angle and native geometry checks. Also record bottle-to-robot (all robot/gripper geoms) and bottle-to-bowl contact pairs at each sampled boundary.
design: This matched batch runs O,A,B,T then repeats O,A,B,T, with a fresh released policy and simulator per path. Verify eight contemporary branches against all four original R1 paths, reported separately. Use the selected neutral B/T clauses, exact native lengths, observations and model assets checked before and after. One layout and one policy key. No extra language choices or stopping rules.
score: Primary: native bowl-on-cabinet at tick 300 AND bottle pose within archived translation/rotation limits for the entire period from original t0. Also score first native placement, first 5 consecutive goal + bowl-gripper-clear ticks, first bottle violation and its relation to released placement, first direct robot/bottle contact. Describe robot EEF-to-bottle-origin distance at policy query boundaries after released placement as a distance measure only.
decision: Compare new B versus T on the exact same qualifying prefix. If B alone violates after release in both repeats, the selected neutral bottle mention is sufficient for a difference versus this neutral table sentence on this fixture. If both preserve, neutral bottle mention does not reproduce the O outcome here. If both violate, this pair does not single out bottle mention. If only T violates, record the reverse pattern. Separate failure to place, pre-release violation, missing measurements, or divergent endpoint repeats. Compare O/A as historical references; one setting and one pair of phrasings do not establish a population rate or general semantic mechanism. Full replay, outcome repeatability and fixed-action physical replay are distinct.

words.template: The {} is also visible in the current scene.
words.selection: Before any new rollout, take the first natural shared template in the ordered language-only check that gives 22 native tokens for both referents. Same goal sentence and punctuation as R1. No position, action requirement, negation or protected-object instruction in the new clauses. Table surface is a visible nontarget in this scene.

source_replay.rationale: The unanchored B/T batch had identical initial observations to historical O/A, but its live first two commands differed by up to 0.000915344726562406 on the original action scale. This repair was specified after reading the first batch. Keep all its paths separately, without selecting an outcome. New batch repeats all four fixed wordings twice in the same container with shared compilation cache, no changes to thresholds, seed or prompts.
source_replay.implementation: At t0 issue exactly one native protected-source query to consume the same model RNG call and store its complete reply. Execute the first two historical O_1 source commands, with its actual original queue as the source of those actions. Check t0 and tau physics, controllers, observations and first two outcomes exactly against the sealed reference tape. Discard the remaining three queued actions at tau, then use only current policy queries through 300. Preserve live and replayed replies separately.
